findings.status: unresolved source-proven boundary; not covered by frozen210 fixtures
findings.input: Public injected clock with same local components 2026-08-08 12:21:18.123456789 and FixedZone offset -1 through -59 seconds; both Go and Rust clock types can represent it
findings.reason: Go chooses sign from zone := offset/60 after integer truncation; negative offsets whose truncated minutes equal0 take the positive branch. Rust chooses sign from raw offset<0. Existing subminute fixture offset19845 is positive and cannot detect this.
findings.required_next_step: Freeze additive actual public frozen-Go clock observations before a genuine Rust RED/fix; do not change any existing fixture expectation. No supplemental runtime capture was run by this read-only reviewer.
